summary: Santander UK plc filed a 6-K announcing completion of its cash acquisition of TSB Banking Group plc. The total consideration paid to Sabadell was £2.65 billion plus an estimated TNAV variation of ~£213 million, financed from existing cash and parent funding. Regulatory approvals were obtained from the PRA and ECB. The deal was approved by Sabadell shareholders. Integration via a Part VII banking business transfer is planned for H1 2027, subject to court sanction and regulatory non-objection. The acquisition makes Santander UK the third-largest UK bank by current account balances and targets a 16% RoTE by 2028 with £400 million+ cost synergies. Post-closing CET1 ratio is 14%, above minimum requirements. Risk-arb watch: focus on TNAV adjustment mechanics, integration timeline, and synergy realization.
